scope: scripts/qualify_drives.py, 44 steps: one G120C PN in an owned scratch; besides the parameter and main telegram number changes, the main telegram's input channel resized to 4 words and restored, an additional telegram inserted (2/2 words), its input channel resized to 4 words with keepOriginalAddress, restored and erased; a torque telegram 750 refused by Startdrive.
limitations: The drive is on no IO system, so its telegrams have no start addresses and keepOriginalAddress is not observable here.
Torque telegrams are refused by Startdrive on the G120C PN; no drive that accepts one was available.

restore the parameter change from its checkpoint

restore the telegram change from its checkpoint
